api/src/scheduler/__init__.py.name: Scheduler package
api/src/scheduler/__init__.py.description: Marks the part of the platform that decides when scheduled work runs.

api/src/scheduler/api_host.py.name: Control inside the server
api/src/scheduler/api_host.py.description: Runs the platform's background control loops inside each main server instance.

api/src/scheduler/control.py.name: Control loops
api/src/scheduler/control.py.description: Runs the recurring platform control work, such as timetables and builds, with only one instance in charge.

api/src/scheduler/health.py.name: Scheduler heartbeat
api/src/scheduler/health.py.description: Shows that the scheduler is alive and ready, so the platform can restart it if it stops.

api/src/scheduler/kubernetes_host.py.name: Hosted control helper
api/src/scheduler/kubernetes_host.py.description: Runs the background control loops on older hosted setups that give the scheduler its own access.

api/src/scheduler/leadership.py.name: One scheduler in charge
api/src/scheduler/leadership.py.description: Elects a single scheduler to own the timetable so no scheduled work runs twice.

api/src/scheduler/main.py.name: Scheduler entry point
api/src/scheduler/main.py.description: Starts the scheduler that keeps time for the platform's recurring work.

api/src/scheduler/registry.py.name: System schedule list
api/src/scheduler/registry.py.description: Lists the platform's built-in recurring tasks and what each one does.
